name: browse_texts_fixed.py_linting
observations: Multiple docstring issues (D205, D400, D102, D103) - missing docstrings and incorrect formatting
Unused imports (F401): re, signal, time, HTTPError, URLError
Multiple whitespace issues (E221, E222) in CSS string formatting
Multiple statements on one line with missing whitespace (E702, E231)
F541 errors: f-strings missing placeholders
Whitespace before } (E202) in multiple locations
Main linting issues identified:
1. Unused imports: re, signal, time, HTTPError, URLError need to be removed
2. CSS string formatting in f-strings causing Pylance errors about undefined variables
3. Multiple statements on one line with missing whitespace (E702, E231)
4. Docstring formatting issues (D400, D102, D103)
5. Multiple spaces before/after operators (E221, E222)
6. F-strings missing placeholders (F541)
Root cause identified: CSS is embedded directly in Python file, causing flake8 to incorrectly parse CSS as Python code
Solution needed: Refactor to separate CSS into dedicated static files
Current architecture mixes concerns: HTML templating, CSS styling, and server logic all in one file
